findings.claim: When data[gasParameter] is null, Number(null) evaluates to 0, which passes the Number.isFinite() check even though it is not a valid oracle value; the code should explicitly check for null and throw a missing-parameter error instead of silently treating it as zero.

The Etherscan parsing path has the same issue as the non-Etherscan path: null values in the response would be coerced to 0 by Number(null) and pass validation instead of being treated as missing data.
